records.subject: Welcome aboard, Granite Labs
records.body:
Hi Wei,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: A hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Wei,

I know you've heard from us a couple of times already, so I'll keep this short. You haven't created a project yet, and that's usually the first step that makes everything else fall into place -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

If it's easier, I'm happy to hop on a 15-minute call this week and set up that first project with you, so you can see how your team's work would map into Wrenfield.

Best,
Nadia
